1.explanation:
• Toggle/Toggle.mdx documents the Toggle component’s API, including required props, examples of aria-label versus labelText, and accessibility guidance. It’s the primary reference for expected behavior and prop wiring.  
• ToggleSmall/ToggleSmall.mdx shows the smaller variant of the same component with identical aria-label handling, so it helps confirm whether the issue is shared across both component sizes. Together, these docs let you reproduce the scenario, compare prop usage patterns, and validate fixes in both Toggle flavors.
1.bug_scenario: The issue arises when a developer provides an aria-label prop to the Carbon Toggle component (e.g. aria-label=“Bluetooth”) but VoiceOver still announces the default or internal description (“Tick box”) instead of the custom label. In the provided screen recording, the first toggle is visually labeled via aria-label but VoiceOver reads “Bluetooth, unticked, Tick box” rather than honoring the aria-label alone; the second toggle uses the non-required labelText prop, which likewise isn’t exposed correctly to assistive technology without additional props.
